propositions: _commit_binding_store_snapshot bypasses the unified write lock by calling raw git_adapter.add + commit without acquiring write_lock, creating a race with ticket-CLI _push_tickets_branch and concurrent GHA commit-back
alert_store._atomic_write hand-rolls tempfile + os.replace instead of using the shared rebar._store.fsutil.atomic_write seam

_commit_binding_store_snapshot must be migrated to push.commit_and_push_tickets_branch(tracker_dir, message=..., strict=True) with fail-open error handling and clean-tree no-commit semantics preserved

alert_store._atomic_write must use fsutil.atomic_write with retained parent mkdir, 0o600 permissions, and fsync durability, as bridge_alerts is git-ignored local scratch (not tracked on tickets branch)

The git add -A widening in commit_and_push_tickets_branch commits all pending .tickets-tracker state (which should only be tickets-branch artifacts), matching GHA commit-back behavior; an unrelated pending file (e.g. projects.json) is included in the same locked commit and must be pinned by test

Existing selective 5-file staging logic and per-file idempotency in _commit_binding_store_snapshot must be replaced; last-pass.json publication on every pass requires contract/test update or seam pathspec extension to preserve prior idempotency behavior
